audience: developers, hiring managers, and tech builders
tone: conversational, practical, and insightful (no corporate jargon)

prompt_templates.name: 3 Practical Takeaways
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this with a punchy opening hook, 3 concise bulleted takeaways, and one discussion question at the end.

prompt_templates.name: Sharpen Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the core ideas, but rewrite the opening 2 lines into a scroll-stopping hook.

prompt_templates.name: Builder Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Reframe this as a first-person story highlighting the real problem, what changed, and the practical lesson.

prompt_templates.name: Make Concise
prompt_templates.prompt: Tighten the post by ~35% for crisp mobile reading while keeping the key insight.

voice_profiles.name: Direct Engineer
voice_profiles.instructions: Clear, pragmatic software engineer voice. Grounded, concrete, short sentences, zero corporate fluff.

voice_profiles.name: Conversational Builder
voice_profiles.instructions: Warm, approachable peer-to-peer builder tone. Curious, honest, and easy to read.

voice_profiles.name: Sharp & Opinionated
voice_profiles.instructions: Confident, concise, thoughtful contrarian angle backed by practical experience—never clickbait.
